description: Gives a one-time upload link (15 minutes, this person only) to drop their own photo or logo into a design: a photo fills its frame, a product or person is cut out, a logo takes a corner and gives its colours. Use it when the person has a picture you cannot pass as `file` / `image_url` (in Claude an attached picture never reaches a tool): make the design first, give them the link, and ask them to say when it is in. Example: { design, picture_is: «product» }.

artboard.description: one artboard only (get_design); none: every artboard of the design

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

picture_is.description: photo (fills the photo frame), product or person (cut out, in the cut-out place), logo (a corner + its colours as the brand’s); auto (default): read from the file

name: upload_picture
title: Add my picture
